provenance.definition: The prompt-ablation table, built from an arm map: per judge, its naive, encouraged and forced arms, each a condition of a named campaign root; the rows are keyed by the prompt slots (naive, encouraged, forced) and each names the prompt style, condition and root of its two arms. Every arm's flat grid is rebuilt from its draws and matched to its estimates by digest; each contrast is baseline minus treatment, the scenario-cluster bootstrap interval and the scenario-clustered paired randomization p at the campaigns' shared settings (contrast_row, the aggregate's own function), equal to the aggregate's row where both arms share a root that pairs them; Holm (p_holm) and Benjamini-Hochberg (p_bh) over every row of the table. A judge's arms share one condition identity but the prompt style (the label rule included). cross_stack marks a row whose arms ran on different local inference stacks (their packages only, never a serving setting), allowed only for the naive arm against the judge's encouraged or forced arm and only where the arm map declares it (cross_stack_reason); every other contrast is held to one stack and serving setup. A judge's arms' roots share the campaign settings that shape an arm's outcomes (attempts, retry scope, request block, seed base).
provenance.multiplicity: fdr_bh in p_bh and holm in p_holm, each recomputed over every contrast in this table; the per-root p_holm in the estimates files is a per-campaign family and is not reused; holm_mc_margin marks a Holm decision another permutation seed could flip (a step within 3 Monte Carlo standard errors of alpha)
provenance.pairing: scenario_id over one frozen manifest shared by every root; a judge's arms joined across roots by the arm map
